label: Whatever is IMMENSE_2 is present by giving being to everything else whenever it is
paraphrase: In every history of the model, whatever is IMMENSE_2 (INFINITE_1 and causing the being of every other being in act as to being) is, at every moment at which another thing is present, present itself and giving that thing being (PresentToAllWheneverTheyAre). The typed presence step of the immensity sense bridge 8bf775e9, derived from the sustaining reading of the cause of being, presence-in-act and the contact principle; only the creator conjunct of IMMENSE_2 is used. Not IMMENSE_1: no place, containment, measure, presence by power or by knowledge, or immediacy.
